description:
The Markdown file editor offers a live side-by-side editor and preview. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a directory holding draft.md: a heading "Draft", a table and a js code block. "The editor pane" is the modal's ".diff-viewer-editor". To "open F": press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier (on whatever has focus); wait for the finder input ".grp-filter" to be visible; fill it with F; wait for the FIRST ".grp-row" to contain F (assert_text_contains on ".grp-row", which checks the first match: the finder lists every file until the query applies, and Enter opens the top row, so waiting for any row with the text is not enough); press Enter in the finder input; the dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name matches the regular expression /Edit .*F/ is then "the modal" for F, and its ".monaco-editor" should become visible (up to 15s). "The preview" is the modal's region (role "region") named "Markdown preview". "The editor input" is the modal's ".monaco-editor textarea.inputarea"; to focus it, eval its focus(). Key presses go to whatever has focus; do not click anything to focus first unless a step says so. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open draft.md. 3. Click the modal's button named "Split view". 4. The preview's table should be visible. 5. The editor pane's right edge must meet the preview's left edge: with getBoundingClientRect(), Math.abs(pane.x + pane.width - preview.x) < 3. 6. The editor input should already be focused (assert_focused): the app focuses it, so the test must not focus it itself. 7. Press "End" with the Control modifier. 8. Type, key by key, "

## New while typing" (each 
 presses Enter). 9. The preview should show a visible heading (an h1-h6 element) with the text "New while typing". 10. Click the modal's button named "Preview mode". 11. The editor pane should be hidden, and the preview should still show a visible heading "New while typing". 12. The preview's "pre > code" should come to have a data-shelley-code-highlight attribute of exactly "js" or "javascript" (poll: it reads "pending" while highlighting loads). 13. Press "K" with the modifiers Control+Shift (this goes back to the mode before preview: split view). 14. The editor pane and the preview should both be visible. 15. Press "p" (lowercase) with the modifiers Control+Alt. 16. The editor pane should be hidden. 17. Set the viewport to width 390, height 844 (only width and height). 18. The modal should come to have exactly 0 buttons named "Split view". 19. Press "p" (lowercase) with the modifiers Control+Alt. 20. The editor pane should be visible, and there must be exactly 0 previews in the modal.
